about: Office font -> free match. Data: office-font-map by JesusLovesYou1013, CC BY 4.0. o: options, metric-compatible first then measured rank; f family, m metric-compatible, s size factor (apply only when m=0), w width at same size, l line factor; pkg Arch package, gf google/fonts dir, gh GitHub owner/repo/dir. wt: weight of the Office family when its name carries one.
